What’s new in HappyLulu

Read what changed, which platform supports it, and how to download each version.

Mac and Windows have different release versions and features. Mac 1.5.18 improves icon render caching across repeated appearance changes and the full padded sidebar click area. The departure visibility option from 1.5.17 remains supported. Windows remains at 1.5.13.

Clearer guidance for elapsed time after departure and the two-hour reference.

  • Explains time examples and when guidance is hidden: no record or a day off.
